observed_failure: boundary and auxiliary iMF each achieved 0/9 successes and zero return at 4 NFE after 5000 training steps; more than 79 percent of executed actions required clipping
hypothesis: the task failure is already visible offline as poorly calibrated first actions rather than arising only from closed-loop compounding
exact_change: none; compare frozen paired EMA checkpoints on identical held-out conditions and identical sampling noise
expected_if_true: both methods have high generated-action clipping or action error and auxiliary does not consistently improve those metrics
expected_if_false: auxiliary has clearly better offline action and interior-state errors despite equal real-task failure, shifting evidence toward temporal or control limitations
metrics: first-action raw MAE and RMSE to held-out action
interior normalized observation MAE and RMSE
generated and target action distribution by dimension
integrity: checkpoint SHA256 and step match frozen protocol
exactly four denoiser calls per batch
interpretation_limits: pointwise error is only a diagnostic under multimodal behavior
128 validation windows do not replace native policy evaluation
no causal data, representation, temporal, or control claim is permitted without a targeted ablation
